what: Text lines appear from below the screen (110~120vh) lying sideways (rotateY 90°), twist around the vertical axis and exit upward — each line runs the same 39s linear loop delayed by .5s per line, so a block of text winds upward like a spiral ribbon (perspective 50vh, backface hidden, tilted 10°). The shape changes with screen ratio: below portrait 2:3 −150°·−70vh·text 2vh, 2:3~1:1 −180°·−100vh·2.5vh, 1:1~3:2 −270°·−190vh·3.5vh, 3:2~2:1 −320°·−240vh·4vh (breakpoint every 25%), above 2:1 −390°·−290vh·4.5vh

options.dur: Time for one line to pass fully from bottom to top (sec), default 39
options.step: Delay between rows (seconds), default .5 — smaller means tighter bands
options.start: First line delay (s, negative means already in progress), default −21.5
options.pause: If hover, pauses while the pointer is over it

note:
Part for full screen height (100vh) boards — position·text size are in vh so shrinking the board makes the line run outside it. Empty line (
  • ) also takes up one line so paragraph gaps widen. As in the original, chaining three copies of the same text keeps the band unbroken for one loop (line count × step close to dur). With reduced motion it stands as a center-aligned text column without the spiral.
